name: Sugarcane Straw Field Burning
notes:
Based on emission factors defined in Excel spreadseet in the EF sheet for grams/kg of straw bured in the field.
Emission factors are calculated from excel based on the low heating value of the straw.

Updated PM2.5 emission factor and the BC and POC emission factors are based on study published by Cai and Wang (2014): Cai H and Wang M. Consideration of Black Carbon and Primary Organic Carbon Emissions in Life-Cycle Analysis of Greenhouse Gas Emissions of Vehicle Systems and Fuels. Environ. Sci. Technol., 2014, 48 (20), pp 12445-12453
DOI: 10.1021/es503852u.

name: NG SC Turbine (EIA/EPA) for ASCC
notes:
The 2010, 2015, and 2020 emission factors in g/mmBtu are calculated based on the EIA and EPA unit-level data.

Reference: Hao Cai, Michael Wang, Amgad Elgowainy, Jeongwoo Han. Updated Greenhouse Gas and Criteria Air Pollutant Emission Factors of the U.S. Electric Generating Units in 2010. October 25, 2013. https://greet.es.anl.gov/publication-electricity-13

name: Stationary Reciprocating Engine - Conventional Gasoline
notes:
The emission factors for 2013 and 2020 are from the ERG analysis for Argonne National Laboratory. The 2010 and 2015 emission factors are assumed the same as those in 2015. 

Reference: https://greet.es.anl.gov/publication-emission-factors-2014

name: Turbine
notes:
The emission factors for 2013 and 2020 are from the ERG analysis for Argonne National Laboratory. The 2010 and 2015 emission factors are assumed the same as those in 2015. 

Reference: https://greet.es.anl.gov/publication-emission-factors-2014

name: CO2 Sequestration for electricity generation from NG
notes: This technology is created to account the CO2 sequestration credit for G.H2 production using NG as resource (raw material).

name: Small Industrial Boiler - Renewable Natural Gas
notes: It is assumed that this combustion technology has the same emission factors as those for NG-fired industrial boilers.
